title: The empty frame, the last time
logline: The 8×10 black frame from March 2001 one more time, in a window on a side street, with something in it the page draws as glare. The page has followed it from the shop to the bin to a buyer to here, and stops following. The sequence's last page in the box.

panels.composition: A black picture frame standing in a side-street house's window, its contents lost in glare, curtains behind it, the street's reflection on the glass.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a black picture frame standing in a side-street house window with its contents lost in glare, curtains behind and the street reflected on the glass, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
